title: Current progress in the targeted therapy of breast cancer: Structure-activity correlation and docking studies (2015-2021).
authors: Pandey, Shivanshu; Mondal, Sitanshu; Kajal, Kumari; Kurmi, Balak Das; Verma, Sant Kumar; Patel, Preeti
one_liner_zh: 该文综述乳腺癌靶向治疗中多种靶点的抑制剂结构-活性关系与分子对接研究，但核心对象为小分子-蛋白靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分对接方法可借鉴。
abstract: Despite cancer research and therapy, breast cancer remains a complicated health crisis in women and represents a top biomedical research priority. Nowadays, breast cancer is an extremely heterogeneous disease and is known as the leading cause of death among women worldwide. The incidence and mortality rates of breast cancer have been increasing gradually for the past decades. Nowadays, common treatments for breast cancer are chemotherapy, endocrine therapy, immunotherapy, radiotherapy, and surgery. The most common targets in breast cancer treatment are human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) and estrogen receptors. The literature suggests that several targets/pathways are also involved in the development of breast cancer, that is, poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP), bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4), cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 (CDK4/6), epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), vascular endothelial growth factor receptor (VEGFR), polo-like kinase 1 (PLK1), phosphoinositide 3-kinases/protein kinase B/mammalian target of rapamycin (PI3K/AKT/mTOR), histone deacetylase (HDAC), nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB), PD-L1, and aromatase inhibitors. Meanwhile, the study of breast cancer is a hot topic in the current scenario of basic/clinical research. This review article provides information on different targets associated with breast cancer and summarizes the progress of current research on synthesized inhibitors as anti-breast cancer agents from 2015 to 2021. The review aims to provide structure-activity relationship and docking studies for designing novel compounds for breast cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 尽管癌症研究和治疗不断进步，乳腺癌仍然是女性面临的复杂健康危机，并被视为生物医学研究的首要优先事项。如今，乳腺癌是一种高度异质性疾病，并被认为是全球女性死亡的主要原因。过去几十年来，乳腺癌的发病率和死亡率逐渐上升。目前，乳腺癌的常见治疗方法包括化疗、内分泌治疗、免疫治疗、放疗和手术。乳腺癌治疗中最常见的靶点是人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）和雌激素受体。文献表明，多种靶点/通路也参与乳腺癌的发生发展，即聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）、含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）、细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4/6（CDK4/6）、表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）、血管内皮生长因子受体（VEGFR）、polo样激酶1（PLK1）、磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B/哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白（PI3K/AKT/mTOR）、组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）、核因子κB（NF-kappaB）、PD-L1和芳香化酶抑制剂。同时，乳腺癌研究是当前基础/临床研究领域的热点。本文综述提供了与乳腺癌相关的不同靶点信息，并总结了2015年至2021年间合成抑制剂作为抗乳腺癌药物的研究进展。本综述旨在提供构效关系和分子对接研究，以设计用于乳腺癌治疗的新型化合物。
